systems.system: Digitalisation de l'état civil (PATN measure for 2027)
systems.owner: Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique (PATN), in support of the Ministère de l'Intérieur
systems.tiers: not stated; listed among measures planned by 2027, with PATN's 2026 work including support for digital applications at the Interior ministry

note: PATN adopted a 2026 budget of 21.872 billion FCFA on 26 February 2026, financed by the World Bank, the EU and the EIB, and lists digitalising civil status among its measures to 2027. The article names no civil registration system and does not say what the digitalisation does, so no fact is taken.
